# What's this?
- Alternative proposal to the per-kWh discount
- Fixed rebate amount per month
  - different rebate per month...helps to avoid large bill shock in Jan/Feb (coldest months)
  - phases out after 10 years on the rate (by when you've presumably paid off the heat pump install?)
- This would be proportionally more beneficial smaller homes (as a proxy for low-income households)
- this would also encourage weatherization
- the fixed amount would be determined by the total cost of the weatherization divided by the number of months in the agreement
